body:
Found the autonomous RSI loop's own ECOWAR work (Phase 2 card input path, cooldown, HUD, combat_log_mod wiring -- commits 882ad47..84d0f10) had pushed with a broken Windows CI build: combat_log_mod.c/*_host.h were correctly added to scripts/build.sh but missed in ci.yml's own separate hardcoded Windows cross-compile step -- the same gap class that already hit bloodflower_mod/tree_passive_mod/card_effect_mod. Fixed the same minimal way; flagged the recurring pattern as worth a real structural fix (glob instead of hardcoded list) later. CI green again, run 33136797159. ECOWAR commit 5252a6e.

⚓ ☃
title: CI fix: Windows cross-compile missing combat_log_mod (4th recurrence of this gap class)
